purpose: Identity verification: read original captured card expiry and compare image text with independent QR in the final review after face capture
necessity: Compare only existing identity fields; do not collect unrelated attributes printed on the card
choice: Unchecked processing choice before capture and final information acknowledgement. No marketing consent bundled
storage: Raw OCR text in request memory only. Automatically read expiry uses existing encrypted/verified identity fields and existing evidence retention. Short-lived capture-bound encrypted receipt in current UI memory; no localStorage, analytics or model training
withdrawal: Abort client request and clear displayed candidates; in-flight local inference may finish before request memory is reclaimed
sharing: Authenticated first-party private KYC service in VN only; no document transfer to upstream GitHub/model hosts
controller: Current verified business configuration; endpoint blocks if legalName/address/privacyEmail are missing
